player_0.content: New plan: I correctly identified the shape as a quadrilateral and selected option (D) kite, but I failed to recognize that the specific coordinates provided in the path (`M 60.76,55.59 L 73.82,59.06 L 78.35,63.06 L 72.33,62.58`) actually form a **pentagon** (5 vertices) rather than a quadrilateral.
